text.text: Not going to sugarcoat this, being an almost decade long Astralis fan. Device doesn’t hit shots that were ez picks a few years back. Cadian is struggling to find a consistent schematic for this roster. Stavn looks depressed 80% of the time. Jabbi is a coin flip for every match he is in. Staehr is really doing he’s best and it’s still not enough. There is no chemistry for this lineup, it feels like. They need a mental coach to spend more time with the players and work on their passion, stability and confidence. Ruggah has to go, there are many, significantly better suiting coaches in the scene. This should end up as a 2:1 for Astralis, just because of a weaker opponent. Landing at 2-2 record in the group stage, most likely would result in a 2-3 finish of this tournament for Astralis. We just have to take it with a grain of salt. The team needs more time to click together. If that does happen, we might see a great contender for top 3. But for as long as the structure of their play remains the same, we’re not going to see much. Please, unleash Stavn and remove Ruggah, and we’ll have “true cinema” on our screens for many years to come.
